task: A portfolio has two assets: 30 units at price 50, and 10 units at price 200 (total value 3500). Total borrowed = 1400. Compute loan-to-value in basis points = borrowed*10000/total_value with truncating integer division (equals 4000). Store the integer as answer. When achieved, finish with rlm_set(~~QT~~Final~~QT~~, true).
lesson: Today I learned `floor` truncates toward zero, so `(/ 14000000 1500)` yields 9333 instead of 9333.33.
